versos.grego: Παῦλος καὶ Σιλουανὸς καὶ Τιμόθεος τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεσσαλονικέων ἐν Θεῷ Πατρὶ ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ·

controles.web: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ:
controles.kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
controles.livre: Paulo, e Silvano, e Timóteo, à igreja dos tessalonicenses, em Deus nosso Pai, e no Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Haja entre vós graça e paz de nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Εὐχαριστεῖν ὀφείλομεν τῷ Θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί, καθὼς ἄξιόν ἐστιν, ὅτι ὑπεραυξάνει ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν καὶ πλεονάζει ἡ ἀγάπη ἑνὸς ἑκάστου πάντων ὑμῶν εἰς ἀλλήλους,

controles.web: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you towards one another abounds;
controles.kjv: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
controles.livre: Nós sempre devemos dar graças a Deus por vós, irmãos, como é o correto, porque vossa fé cresce muito, e o amor de cada um de todos vós pelos outros é cada vez maior;

versos.grego: ὥστε αὐτοὺς ἡμᾶς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐνκαυχᾶσθαι ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑπὲρ τῆς ὑπομονῆς ὑμῶν καὶ πίστεως ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς διωγμοῖς ὑμῶν καὶ ταῖς θλίψεσιν αἷς ἀνέχεσθε,

controles.web: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.
controles.kjv: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
controles.livre: De maneira que nós mesmos nos orgulhamos de vós nas igrejas de Deus, por causa de vossa paciência e fé, em todas as vossas perseguições aflições que suportais;

versos.grego: ἔνδειγμα τῆς δικαίας κρίσεως τοῦ Θεοῦ, εἰς τὸ καταξιωθῆναι ὑμᾶς τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὑπὲρ ἧς καὶ πάσχετε,

controles.web: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of the Kingdom of God, for which you also suffer.
controles.kjv: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
controles.livre: Que é prova clara do justo julgamento de Deus, para que sejais considerados dignos do Reino de Deus, pelo qual também sofreis;

versos.grego: εἴπερ δίκαιον παρὰ Θεῷ ἀνταποδοῦναι τοῖς θλίβουσιν ὑμᾶς θλῖψιν

controles.web: Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
controles.kjv: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
controles.livre: Pois é justo diante de Deus pagar com aflição aos que vos afligem;

versos.grego: καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς θλιβομένοις ἄνεσιν μεθ’ ἡμῶν, ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ μετ’ ἀγγέλων δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ

controles.web: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,
controles.kjv: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
controles.livre: E a vós que sois afligidos, alívio conosco, quando o Senhor Jesus aparecer do céu com os anjos de seu poder,

versos.grego: ἐν πυρὶ φλογός, διδόντος ἐκδίκησιν τοῖς μὴ εἰδόσιν Θεὸν καὶ τοῖς μὴ ὑπακούουσιν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ,

controles.web: giving vengeance to those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
controles.kjv: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
controles.livre: Com labareda de fogo, vingando os que não conhecem a Deus, e os que não obedecem ao Evangelho do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,

versos.grego: οἵτινες δίκην τίσουσιν ὄλεθρον αἰώνιον ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δόξης τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
controles.kjv: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
controles.livre: Os quais serão punidos com o castigo da eterna perdição, longe da face do Senhor, e da glória de sua força;

versos.grego: ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐνδοξασθῆναι ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ καὶ θαυμασθῆναι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύσασιν, ὅτι ἐπιστεύθη τὸ μαρτύριον ἡμῶν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς, ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ.

controles.web: when he comes to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired among all those who have believed (because our testimony to you was believed) in that day.
controles.kjv: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
controles.livre: Quando ele vier para ser glorificado em seus santos, e naquele dia se fazer admirável em todos os que creem (porque nosso testemunho entre vós foi crido).

versos.grego: Εἰς ὃ καὶ προσευχόμεθα πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἵνα ὑμᾶς ἀξιώσῃ τῆς κλήσεως ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ πληρώσῃ πᾶσαν εὐδοκίαν ἀγαθωσύνης καὶ ἔργον πίστεως ἐν δυνάμει,

controles.web: To this end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith, with power;
controles.kjv: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
controles.livre: Por isso que também sempre rogamos por vós, que nosso Deus vos faça dignos do chamamento, e cumpra todo bom desejo e a obra da fé com poder.

versos.grego: ὅπως ἐνδοξασθῇ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν αὐτῷ, κατὰ τὴν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Para que o nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja glorificado em vós, e vós nele, segundo a graça de nosso Deus, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
